title: Two unlocked increments interleave and one is lost
caption: count += 1 is read, add, write. Schedule A, B, A, B: both threads read 0, so counter = 1 instead of 2.

messages.label: read
messages.note: A reads the counter into its private copy.

messages.label: read
messages.note: B reads before A has written back.

messages.label: write 1
messages.note: B writes its stale 0 + 1 over A's result. counter = 1, expected 2: A's increment is lost.

scenarios.name: With a lock
scenarios.summary: The lock makes read-add-write one critical section: B waits at acquire until A releases, and the result is 2.

messages.label: read 0, write 1
messages.note: A's whole read-add-write runs inside the lock.

messages.label: acquire (blocks)
messages.note: B wants the lock and blocks until A releases it.
